findings.subject: /nodes/41
findings.note: The skinned mesh HeavyWalkerMech_Body sits under HeavyWalkerMech, whose transform is identity, so a runtime that ignores parent transforms for skinned meshes draws it in the same place. Accepted.
Owner accepted 2026-11-18: the served GLB is skinned, so the flush check measured none of its triangles; verified on its views and the other QA checks.
